description: Test file for Discord allowlist common utility functions. Contains unit tests for functions like resolving and filtering guilds, building unresolved results, and normalizing allowlist tokens.

methods.name: buildDiscordUnresolvedResults
methods.description: Builds an array of unresolved result objects based on input array and a resolver function.

methods.name: filterDiscordGuilds
methods.description: Filters guilds based on provided criteria such as guildId or guildName.

methods.name: findDiscordGuildByName
methods.description: Finds a Discord guild object by its name.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAllowlistToken
methods.description: Normalizes and resolves an allowlist token string, trimming whitespace and handling empty input.
